lines.text: Many learners say: Where I can buy a ticket?
Better: Where can I buy a ticket?
Can I! Where can I buy water?

data.wrong: Where I can buy a ticket?
data.right: Where can I buy a ticket?

native.tip: Kita bilang “Di mana saya bisa beli tiket?”, tapi bahasa Inggris menaruh can sebelum I: Where can I buy a ticket?
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Where I can buy a ticket?” 😅 Dalam pertanyaan, can ada sebelum I: “Where can I buy a ticket?” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “can I”. Tulis satu pertanyaan Where can I tentang hal yang ingin kamu beli. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “Di mana saya bisa beli tiket?”, but English puts can before I: Where can I buy a ticket?
en.caption: Ever say this? “Where I can buy a ticket?” 😅 In a question, can goes before I: “Where can I buy a ticket?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
